title: Next fire time of a Vixie-cron expression
skill: Scheduling semantics: the Vixie cron day-of-month / day-of-week OR rule
traps: when both day fields are restricted, a day matches if EITHER matches
a field beginning with '*' (including '*/2') counts as unrestricted for that rule
the result must be strictly after now
impossible schedules (Feb 30) must return None, not loop forever
